tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Dark is the brand's home: black like the posters.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows and the tab bar, on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, steppers, photo frames and the set table's rows; sits inside surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and unselected chips (3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the white strokes of the wordmark, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, previous-set values, captions, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: press-yellow
tokens.usage: The brand yellow, sampled from the logo's arc. Primary button fills, the active tab pill, PR badges and the logo itself. Same in both themes; on light grounds use it as a fill only, never as text or a thin line.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a press-yellow fill (the primary button label). Never white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text: the active tab label, ghost buttons, [ bracket ] titles, the current set number. Press-yellow on dark; ink on light, where it sits on a press-yellow fill (accent-highlight or accent-soft) so the yellow still leads.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind accent text: the current set row, highlighted stat tiles, the active tab pill. A dark yellow tint on dark; full press-yellow on light, with accent (ink) text on it.

tokens.name: accent-highlight
tokens.usage: The yellow band behind BracketTitle. Clear on dark, where the type itself is yellow; press-yellow on light, behind ink type.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Progress arcs: ProgressRing and RestTimer. Press-yellow in both themes, always drawn over ring-track.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: The unfilled track under a progress arc. On light it is a dark warm grey so the yellow arc reads (12:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed sets and on-track states. Teal rather than green so it stays apart from danger for colour-blind users. Always paired with a tick or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text and the completed set row.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missed sessions, failed reps, destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring, 2px off the element. Yellow on dark, ink on light.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Over black-and-white photography so ink and accent type stay legible (programme cards, web hero).

families.sans: Jost, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Century Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, all caps, set tight. The poster voice. One display style per screen.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero and campaign headlines only. Ends with a full stop.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: App moment screens: workout complete, new PR, programme start.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Screen titles and [ bracket ] titles on programme cards.

groups.name: Condensed
groups.note: Barlow Condensed for anything counted or pressed: numbers, labels, buttons, the tagline.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Rest timer and the hero number on a stat screen. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tiles and the weight and reps values in the set logger. Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, the tagline, tab labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headings, table headers, units beside a stat. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Jost, the geometric body face from the posters' paragraph copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lower the bar to mid-chest, pause, then press up and slightly back.
styles.usage: Instructions, descriptions and most running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in rows and cards.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screens use space-5 side gutters on phones and space-10 on web.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside small badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Set row padding; stat label to value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gaps between rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between card groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Web side gutter; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between web sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Web hero vertical padding.

radius.note: Taken from the logo's round stroke ends: controls are pills, containers are softly rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, steppers, set rows, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, programme cards, the tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, the active-tab pill. Echoes the logo's round caps.

shadow.note: Dark UI separates by surface, not shadow. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the floating tab bar, the rest-timer overlay.

stroke.note: Line weights. The brand is drawn with one round-capped line.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Concentric background rings and dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icons, drawn with round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Progress rings and the rest timer, round caps, like the logo's arc.

opacity.note: The echo: a headline repeated down the frame, fading each line, as on the LOCKED IN poster.

tokens.name: echo-1
tokens.usage: First line of an echo headline.

tokens.name: echo-2
tokens.usage: Second line.

tokens.name: echo-3
tokens.usage: Third line.

tokens.name: echo-4
tokens.usage: Fourth line.

tokens.name: echo-5
tokens.usage: Fifth line and beyond.

tokens.name: ring-faint
tokens.usage: Concentric background rings drawn in accent.
